corpus_metadata.name: Wikipedia Paragraph Index for Natural Questions Open (300 Validation Queries)
corpus_metadata.description: Frozen 45,029 paragraph passage index covering the topic entities of the 300 sampled validation questions.
corpus_metadata.source: English Wikipedia (Official Wikimedia Foundation Dump & Article API)

article_selection_protocol.methodology: Question-guided topic discovery without label leakage.
article_selection_protocol.discovery_rule: Topic entities, noun phrases, and candidate Wikipedia titles were extracted solely from the question text (never from gold answer strings) across the 300 sampled validation questions.
article_selection_protocol.expansion: 1-hop hyperlink neighborhood expansion covering related biographical, geographic, historical, and conceptual Wikipedia articles.

paragraph_segmentation_protocol.granularity: Natural Wikipedia paragraph boundaries, bounded to a maximum of 200 whitespace tokens following Lewis et al. (NeurIPS 2020).
filtering: Navigation templates, infobox boilerplate, citations ([1], [citation needed]), and maintenance tags removed.
See Also, References, External Links, and Category sections discarded.
Passages with fewer than 30 tokens filtered out to eliminate non-informative fragments.
